_comment: Graylog event definitions (alerts). 'streams' lists stream titles from streams.json; scripts/provision.sh resolves them to IDs. Priority: 1 low, 2 normal, 3 high. Add notifications (e-mail, Slack, HTTP) in the web interface or via the API and attach them to these definitions.

event_definitions.title: SSH brute force: 5+ failed logins on one host in 5 minutes
event_definitions.description: Many failed SSH logins against the same host. Check ssh_src_ip and ssh_user in the matching messages; block the source or verify key-only authentication.

event_definitions.title: SSH: failed login for root
event_definitions.description: Someone tried to log in as root over SSH. PermitRootLogin should be 'no' or 'prohibit-password'.

event_definitions.title: sudo: command executed
event_definitions.description: A command was run with sudo. Review sudo_user, sudo_target_user and sudo_command; expected for administrators, unexpected for service accounts.

event_definitions.title: sudo: authentication failure or policy violation
event_definitions.description: Wrong sudo password or a user not allowed to run sudo (NOT in sudoers / command not allowed).
event_definitions.query: application_name:sudo AND (message:"incorrect password attempt" OR message:"NOT in sudoers" OR message:"command not allowed" OR message:"authentication failure")

event_definitions.title: Account: new local user created
event_definitions.description: A local account was created (useradd/adduser). Verify it against a change ticket.

event_definitions.title: Account: user added to a privileged group
event_definitions.description: A user was added to wheel, sudo, adm or root. These groups grant administrative access.
event_definitions.query: (message:"add" OR message:"added") AND (message:wheel OR message:sudo OR message:adm OR message:root)
